newsitem.title: USA: Suspected serial killer charged with two deaths.
newsitem.headline: Suspected serial killer charged with two deaths.

text.p: A security guard was charged Friday with killing two women believed to have been prostitutes and police said he was suspected of another death in Illinois and perhaps five similar slayings in California.
Andrew Urdalis, 32, was charged with killing Lynn Huber, 22, of Chicago, whose body was found was found last Aug. 22 in Wolf Lake on the Illinois-Indiana border south of Chicago.
He was also charged with the death of Lori Uylaki, 25, of Hammond, Indiana, whose body was found in the same lake earlier in 1996.

Police said they expected charges would be filed Monday in a third death, that of Cassandra Corum, 21, of Hammond, whose body was found in a river near Pontiac, Illinois, about 75 miles southwest of Chicago, last July 14.
Chicago police Lt. Joseph Murphy said Urdalis confessed to the two slayings with which he was charged, admitting "he had sex with them, killed them, dumped their bodies and got rid of the clothes."
He said police in southern California, where the Chicago man was based while a Marine, are investigating him in as many as five other deaths.
"Based upon the statements he's made to us this should tie up a lot of loose ends," he said.
